source_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.id,e.capture_id,e.seq,e.system,e.channel,e.direction,e.message,e.payload_hex
FROM stg_event e JOIN param_occurrence p ON p.stg_event_id=e.id AND p.project_id=e.project_id
WHERE p.project_id=:pid AND p.system='NR' AND p.path LIKE 'systemInformationBlockType1/%'
ORDER BY e.capture_id,e.seq
count_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT e.capture_id) captures,count(DISTINCT e.id) events FROM stg_event e JOIN param_occurrence p ON p.stg_event_id=e.id AND p.project_id=e.project_id WHERE p.project_id=:pid AND p.system='NR' AND p.path LIKE 'systemInformationBlockType1/%'
